children: Quantinuum's finding that quantum computing error correction improves with scale represents an important milestone in the company's technical progress and shows it catching up to Google, Morgan Stanley analysts write in a note. "The result further solidifies Quantinuum's lead among the pure plays and closes its main gap with Google," they write. While Quantinuum had led the pack in terms of protected operations, Google was ahead in demonstrating that "more protection keeps lowering errors," they write. "Quantinuum has now demonstrated both, with a steeper improvement per step than Google showed in its 2024 result, though Google's result is peer reviewed and was decoded in real time." (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
